text:
oliver: 7-hour layover at AMS on the way to the offsite. thinking of doing a 3-hour city sprint to see a museum + grab stroopwafel. feasible or silly? :world_map:

priya: totally doable. train from Schiphol to Centraal ~15-20m each way + 10-15m to walk. factor customs + security on return. leave 90-120m buffer before flight.

sam: don't forget immigration lines. if it's a Schengen flight in/out it's smoother; transatlantic can add time. check if your arrival is at an international terminal with passport control.

tasha: luggage tip 14 if you have a carry-on only, bring a lightweight daypack and stash it in a luggage locker at Centraal or use the drop-off at the station. lockers can be cashless in most places.

devin: museum recs: Van Gogh or Rijksmuseum are classic, but they have lines. consider FOAM (fotography) if you want something small and fast. pre-book tickets if possible 14 saves time.

oliver: good call on tickets. any fastest route for tickets or storage?

priya: use NS app for train (paperless). for museum tix, buy e-ticket PDF on the museum site and screenshot it. for lockers, try: https://www.ns.nl or station services page.

sam: safety note: keep one copy of flight's boarding pass and set phone alarms. also bring a portable charger 14 you'll be using maps. :battery:

ops-bot: Reminder: if your layover < 6 hours and you're leaving the secure area, update the team travel sheet with arrival/departure times and passport nationality to confirm visa requirements. https://redwood.infra/travel/offsite-2026

tasha: pro tip: wear shoes you can sprint in and keep a foldable tote for souvenirs. if you only have a 7h layover i'd do it 14 short city visit > being stuck at gate for hours.

devin: also check luggage re-check rules with your carrier 14 some carriers auto-transfer, others require you to pick up + re-check. saves panic.

oliver: thanks all 14 sounds like yes, with 2h buffer and prebooked museum + locker. will update the sheet. poll: react :train: if youre team city sprint, :airplane: if youre gate lounge type.
